Appendix — how these were found

Discovery = 1% SYSTEM sample, Oct 10-13 vs Oct 3-9, run 2026-10-15. Step 1 (single flags) fed a 14-flag vocabulary into step 2 (all 2-4 flag combos). Excluded: g-h-device-spoofing-detected-verify-pressure (edited 2026-10-13, zero baseline = definition change, GAME_VERIFY only, not includable). Second pass (Oct 11-14 vs Oct 4-10, 16-flag vocabulary without the header-order/ct-before-cl family): found 3 more combos, now tracked. Excluded as artifacts: g-ip-datacenter, g-ip-datacenter-with-fingerprint, g-ip-hosting-cloud-security, g-ip-connection-type-velocity-short-term-abuse-* and g-ip-asn-reputation-high-risk-with-session-signal (all created 2026-10-14, DETCORE-4371, Internal Test, so new definitions, not attacks); g-spoofing-math-fingerprint-chrome-windows-mismatch (edited 2026-10-06, inside baseline); g--e-g-ja4-suspicious-verification-patterns (Ensemble, re-dated daily). Recurrence (2026-10-15): the spiking keys of all 6 combos were backfilled exactly to Sep 20 (reports/recurrence_2026-10-15.html); 5 of 6 combos come back on the same keys within 3-21 days.
